title: Reinforcement Learning with Reference-Based Rewards for Language Model Reasoning and Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2504.09895v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) powers two major lines of large language model (LLM) post-training: reasoning, which elicits deliberate, verifiable problem solving, and alignment, which steers models toward helpful, harmless, and honest behavior. Both hinge on reward design. Reasoning relies on rule-based verification of final answers, whose binary feedback is blind to intermediate derivations, whereas process reward models (PRMs) require step-level annotations too costly to scale. Alignment depends on reward models (RMs) trained on binary preference pairs, making both data collection and model training resource-intensive. We propose RL2R, reinforcement learning with reference-based rewards, as a unified and inexpensive alternative. Using pre-existing or distilled references, RL2R measures semantic similarity with lightweight metrics such as BERTScore between a sampled generation and a reference answer or solution. translated_title: 基于参考奖励的强化学习用于语言模型推理与对齐
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）支撑着大语言模型（LLM）后训练的两大主要方向：推理，即引导模型进行深思熟虑、可验证的问题求解；以及对齐，即引导模型表现出有益、无害且诚实的行为。两者都依赖于奖励设计。推理依赖于对最终答案的基于规则的验证，其二元反馈无法感知中间推导过程；而过程奖励模型（PRM）需要步骤级标注，成本过高难以规模化。对齐则依赖于在二元偏好对上训练的奖励模型（RM），使数据收集和模型训练都非常耗费资源。我们提出RL2R——基于参考奖励的强化学习，作为一种统一且低成本的替代方案。利用已有的或蒸馏得到的参考答案，RL2R通过轻量级指标（如BERTScore）度量采样生成结果与参考答案或解题过程之间的语义相似度，以相似度……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出RL2R方法，利用参考答案与轻量级语义相似度指标（如BERTScore）作为奖励信号，为语言模型的推理与对齐提供统一且低成本的强化学习后训练方案。
en_tdlr: RL2R uses reference-based semantic similarity rewards (e.g., BERTScore) as a unified and inexpensive alternative to rule-based verifiers and costly reward models for both LLM reasoning and alignment.
